grammar_title: 动名词(-ing form / gerund)作主语
source: 人教版2019选择性必修一 Unit 5 Discovering Useful Structures:动名词作主语(谓语用单数 / it 作形式主语句式 / 动名词复合结构作主语)。句子地道、围绕农业·袁隆平·杂交水稻·有机农业·粮食安全;主语位/固定句式使动名词唯一成立。

points.point: 动名词作主语,谓语用单数
points.overview: 句首主语位用动名词(-ing),把动作'名词化';作主语时视为单数,谓语用 is/was/feeds/widens 等单数形式。to do 可作主语但更正式且常用 it 形式;does/done 不能作主语。

points.point: it 作形式主语 + 动名词(常见固定句式)
points.overview: it 作形式主语、动名词作真正主语后置:It is no use/no good doing…;There is no point (in) doing…;It is a waste of time doing… 等;此处只能用动名词。

points.point: 动名词复合结构作主语 / 动名词主语 vs 不定式主语
points.overview: 动名词前可带逻辑主语(名词所有格/Tom's/his)构成复合结构作主语;并对照'动名词主语(已发生·一般)vs 不定式主语(具体·将来)'的选用。

questions.stem: "____ rice feeds millions of people around the world."
questions.explanation: 句首主语位、动作名词化作主语 → 动名词 Growing;does/done 不能作主语,to grow 在此不如动名词自然。

questions.stem: "____ the land was something Yuan Longping did all his life."
questions.explanation: 主语位用动名词 Working;'to working' 不成形式。

questions.stem: "____ yields in existing fields was the real solution."
questions.explanation: 动名词 Boosting 作主语,谓语用单数 was。

questions.stem: "____ hybrid rice took years of intense effort."
questions.explanation: 主语位动作名词化 → 动名词 Developing;谓语 took 用单数。

questions.stem: "____ enough food for everyone is a huge challenge."
questions.explanation: 动名词 Producing 作主语,谓语用单数 is。

questions.stem: "____ chemical pesticides can harm the soil and our health."
questions.explanation: 主语位用动名词 Using;does/done 类形式不能作主语。

questions.stem: "____ crops every year keeps the soil rich in minerals."
questions.explanation: 动名词 Changing 作主语,谓语用单数 keeps。

questions.stem: "____ animal waste as fertiliser makes the soil healthier."
questions.explanation: 主语位 → 动名词 Using;谓语 makes 单数。

questions.stem: "____ rice as tall as sorghum was once only a dream."
questions.explanation: 动名词 Imagining 作主语,谓语用单数 was。

questions.stem: "____ the soil clean and rich is the goal of organic farming."
questions.explanation: 主语位 → 动名词 Keeping;谓语 is 单数。

questions.stem: "____ a higher yield was what every farmer hoped for."
questions.explanation: 动名词 Attaining 作主语,谓语 was 单数。

questions.stem: "____ world hunger requires both science and hard work."
questions.explanation: 主语位 → 动名词 Tackling;谓语 requires 单数。

questions.stem: "____ in the fields gave Yuan a deep love for the land."
questions.explanation: 动名词 Farming 作主语,谓语用单数 gave。

questions.stem: "____ different crops helps put minerals back into the ground."
questions.explanation: 主语位 → 动名词 Planting;谓语 helps 单数。

questions.stem: "____ research has helped feed not just China but many other countries."
questions.explanation: 动名词 Conducting 作主语,谓语 has helped。

questions.stem: "____ healthy food while protecting the land is far from easy."
questions.explanation: 主语位 → 动名词 Growing;谓语 is 单数。

questions.stem: "____ poverty in the countryside was always close to his heart."
questions.explanation: 动名词 Fighting 作主语,谓语 was 单数。

questions.stem: "____ rich soil is more important than using strong chemicals."
questions.explanation: 主语位 → 动名词 Building;谓语 is 单数。

questions.stem: "____ from the land taught him more than any book could."
questions.explanation: 动名词 Learning 作主语,谓语 taught 单数。

questions.stem: "____ on salty land was made possible by seawater rice."
questions.explanation: 主语位 → 动名词 Farming;谓语 was 单数。

questions.stem: "It is no use ____ over a poor harvest; just try again next year."
questions.explanation: It is no use doing 固定句式,真正主语用动名词 crying。

questions.stem: "It is no good ____ about the weather; farmers must adapt."
questions.explanation: It is no good doing 固定句式,用动名词 complaining。

questions.stem: "There is no point ____ chemicals if they ruin the soil."
questions.explanation: There is no point (in) doing,用动名词 using。

questions.stem: "It is a waste of time ____ crops that no one will buy."
questions.explanation: It is a waste of time doing,用动名词 growing。

questions.stem: "It is no use ____ that the food problem will solve itself."
questions.explanation: It is no use doing,用动名词 hoping。

questions.stem: "It is no good ____ the same field every year without a break."
questions.explanation: It is no good doing,用动名词 farming。

questions.stem: "There is no point ____ a hybrid that cannot survive in the fields."
questions.explanation: There is no point (in) doing,用动名词 creating。

questions.stem: "It is a waste of time ____ for larger fields instead of better seeds."
questions.explanation: It is a waste of time doing,用动名词 wishing。

questions.stem: "It is no use ____ the truth that the soil is becoming poorer."
questions.explanation: It is no use doing,用动名词 hiding。

questions.stem: "It is no good ____ pesticides everywhere without thinking of the cost."
questions.explanation: It is no good doing,用动名词 spreading。

questions.stem: "There is no point ____ that organic food costs more without a reason."
questions.explanation: There is no point (in) doing,用动名词 arguing。

questions.stem: "It is a waste of time ____ about hunger but doing nothing at all."
questions.explanation: It is a waste of time doing,用动名词 talking。

questions.stem: "It is no use ____ that one good harvest will feed a nation forever."
questions.explanation: It is no use doing,用动名词 thinking。

questions.stem: "It is no good ____ to retire when the work is only half done."
questions.explanation: It is no good doing,用动名词 rushing。

questions.stem: "There is no point ____ the same crop until the land is worn out."
questions.explanation: There is no point (in) doing,用动名词 repeating。

questions.stem: "It is a waste of time ____ for an easy answer to world hunger."
questions.explanation: It is a waste of time doing,用动名词 searching。

questions.stem: "It is no use ____ the harvest if the seeds were poor to begin with."
questions.explanation: It is no use doing,用动名词 blaming。

questions.stem: "It is no good ____ the danger of using too many chemicals."
questions.explanation: It is no good doing,用动名词 ignoring。

questions.stem: "There is no point ____ a field that gets no water and no care."
questions.explanation: There is no point (in) doing,用动名词 keeping。

questions.stem: "It is a waste of time ____ harmful insects with the wrong methods."
questions.explanation: It is a waste of time doing,用动名词 fighting。

questions.stem: "Yuan's ____ the first hybrid rice changed farming in China forever."
questions.explanation: 名词所有格 Yuan's + 动名词 developing 构成复合结构作主语。

questions.stem: "His ____ his life to the farmers won the respect of millions."
questions.explanation: his + 动名词 devoting 构成复合结构作主语。

questions.stem: "Tom's ____ to organic methods surprised his whole village."
questions.explanation: Tom's + 动名词 switching 构成复合结构作主语。

questions.stem: "The scientist's ____ seawater rice gave hope to many regions."
questions.explanation: 所有格 + 动名词 creating 构成复合结构作主语。

questions.stem: "Grandpa's ____ chemical fertilisers is the reason he farms organically."
questions.explanation: Grandpa's + 动名词 avoiding 构成复合结构作主语。

questions.stem: "The farmers' ____ new strains led to far better harvests."
questions.explanation: 所有格 + 动名词 planting 构成复合结构作主语。

questions.stem: "Her ____ the soil every season keeps the land healthy."
questions.explanation: her + 动名词 testing 构成复合结构作主语。

questions.stem: "My uncle's ____ to the countryside let him grow his own food."
questions.explanation: 所有格 + 动名词 moving 构成复合结构作主语。

questions.stem: "____ rice every day reminds us how precious each grain is. (强调一般、已成习惯的事)"
questions.explanation: 表示一般性、习惯性的事实作主语,用动名词 Eating(而非具体一次的不定式)。

questions.stem: "____ enough food for a growing world is the dream of every farmer. (泛指一般情况)"
questions.explanation: 泛指一般情况作主语,用动名词 Growing。

questions.stem: "____ the soil with care brings a better harvest in the long run. (强调长期的、习惯性做法)"
questions.explanation: 强调长期、习惯性做法作主语,用动名词 Treating。

questions.stem: "____ from spilt milk helps no one; farmers look to the next season. (谚语:固定用动名词)"
questions.explanation: 谚语 Crying over spilt milk;动名词作主语。

questions.stem: "His ____ never to give up inspired a new generation of scientists."
questions.explanation: his + 动名词 choosing 构成复合结构作主语。

questions.stem: "The village's ____ to natural fertiliser slowly made its fields richer."
questions.explanation: 所有格 + 动名词 turning 构成复合结构作主语。

questions.stem: "____ different crops in turn protects the land year after year. (强调反复、一般的做法)"
questions.explanation: 强调反复、一般做法作主语,用动名词 Growing。

questions.stem: "Mary's ____ organic vegetables made her shop popular in town."
questions.explanation: Mary's + 动名词 selling 构成复合结构作主语。

questions.stem: "____ the land was, for Yuan, the same as serving the people. (泛指一般性的事)"
questions.explanation: 泛指一般性的事作主语,用动名词 Serving。

questions.stem: "The team's ____ the experiment in the south saved another year of work."
questions.explanation: 所有格 + 动名词 running 构成复合结构作主语。

questions.stem: "____ good seeds matters more than owning larger fields. (泛指一般情况)"
questions.explanation: 泛指一般情况作主语,用动名词 Choosing;谓语 matters 单数。

questions.stem: "Their ____ the soil free of chemicals kept their crops safe to eat."
questions.explanation: their + 动名词 keeping 构成复合结构作主语。
